page.layout: One printed page, one column of text. Above the text: a decorative woodcut border (not transcribed). Then the dedication heading block, centred. Then the body text, with a woodcut initial I at the left beside the first lines. At the foot: a gathering signature "* 2" at centre-left. No running head and no page number.

main_text.head: Nobilissimo, ampliss. & illustrissimo DOMINO, D. JOHANNI GORDONIO Lacu-varriæ domino, Kain-murij Vice-comiti, Gratiam & pacem à Domino.
main_text.p: Ibrorum (domine ampliffime) haud aliter quàm foliorum arborum, adolescente jam vere, permagna est copia: scripturire quam parturire mallet hoc sæculum, & vi-tam chartaceam nemo non optat. Quor-sum ego itaque scriberem? an quia stultum & ignavum peritura parcere charta? an ve-ro, quod verius est, quoniam hoc ha-bent miserrima & deflenda ecclesiæ fa-ta, senescente jam mundo, ut veritas, quæ nullum forum reformidat, nullum tribunal perhorrescit, nunquam non in jus & quæstionem rea petrahatur, & theologia jam tantum non arena gladia-toria

page.notes: The woodcut initial is an ornamental I, joined to "brorum" as printed. The top border and the decorative ornament are not text and are left out. Doubtful: "petrahatur" is read as printed, with a comma after it in the scan. The printer uses "quàm" with a grave accent, kept as printed.
